title: IT Support Technician
description:
Keep 9 school campuses running.

What you'll do
- Fix laptops, printers and classroom displays
- Set up accounts for new staff

Requirements
- Associate's degree in IT or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of help desk or desktop support experience
- Experience with Windows, Active Directory and Microsoft 365
- Valid driver's license and ability to travel between campuses

Preferred
- CompTIA A+
- PowerShell scripting

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
We turn traffic sensor data into travel-time predictions.

You will
- Build batch pipelines from raw sensor feeds
- Keep data quality checks green

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in a technical field
- Python and SQL
- Experience with Airflow or a similar orchestrator
- Exposure to cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
- 0-2 years of experience

Nice to have
- dbt
- AWS

title: Machine Learning Engineer, NLP
description:
Build models that read clinical notes so nurses don't have to.

Responsibilities
- Train and ship NLP models for triage
- Monitor model quality in production

Requirements
- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related field
- 2+ years of industry experience training and deploying NLP models
- PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers
- Must be authorized to work in the U.S.; we are unable to sponsor visas

Preferred
- Retrieval systems (RAG)
- HIPAA

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Own the data platform behind grid forecasting.

Requirements
- 8+ years of data engineering experience
- Expert SQL and Python
- Spark and Kafka at scale
- Experience leading a team of engineers

Preferred
- Terraform
- Snowflake

title: Help Desk Analyst
description:
Be the first call when a branch's tech breaks.

Requirements
- High school diploma required; college coursework a plus
- 1+ years of customer-facing technical support
- Familiarity with Windows 11 and Microsoft 365
- Excellent written communication

Nice to have
- ServiceNow or a similar ticketing system

title: AI Engineer (New Grad)
description:
Join a 12-person team shipping LLM features for utilities.

What you'll do
- Build retrieval and evaluation pipelines
- Ship features end to end with a mentor

Requirements
- BS in Computer Science or a related field (graduating by June 2026)
- Strong Python
- Built at least one project using LLM APIs or retrieval-augmented generation
- No prior full-time experience required

Nice to have
- PyTorch
- Docker
- AWS
